newsitem.title: GREECE: NATL SECURITIES TOPS OCT MARKET SHARE, BOURSE VOLUME UP.
newsitem.headline: NATL SECURITIES TOPS OCT MARKET SHARE, BOURSE VOLUME UP.

text.p: National Bank subsidiary National Securities led Greek brokers in October market share with 25.47 percent of the bourse's trading volume after a bout of large block trades in shares of several National Bank subsidiaries.

Sigma Securities took second place with 9.57 percent, an improvement over September's 8.77 percent. Steadily in third place was N. Devletoglou with 5.02 percent followed by Telesis Securities with 3.61 percent.

Kappa Securities ranked sixth, solidifying its position in the top tier after a fast climb in recent months. It did 3.47 of the bourse's trading volume in October, a touch under Alpha Brokerage at number four.
Euroxx put out steady performance following closely with 3.01 percent.

Trading volume in October improved to 411.4 billion drachmas from 382.7 billion in September. January remained the bourse's best month so far this year with turnover hitting 428.8 billion drachmas. The year's low was recorded in May at 209 billion.
Cumulative January-to-October turnover reached 3.036 trillion drachmas, the Athens stock exchange association of member brokers (SMEHA) said.
The association's most recent member P & K Securities improved to 26th place with 0.80 percent.
